meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 当你想给 NanoClaw 加新渠道、改触发规则或加集成时，Claude 会先提问弄清需求，再调用现成安装命令或修改配置，并让你动手验证。
howto.when: 当你提到要添加 Telegram、Slack 等渠道，或想改触发词、加集成、改路由时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 Telegram 加为输入渠道。
say.note: 它会先问接到哪个代理组、隔离级别等。

say.text: 给代理组 A 接入 Gmail 工具。
say.note: 会确认服务、操作权限并调用对应安装技能。

say.text: 改一下某个触发词对应的代理组。
say.note: 会更新 wirings 的触发规则。

howto.what_en: When you want to add new channels, change trigger rules, or add integrations to NanoClaw, Claude asks clarifying questions first, then runs a dedicated install skill or edits config, and tells you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention adding channels like Telegram or Slack, or want to change triggers, add integrations, or modify the router.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It asks which agent group and isolation level.

say_en.text: Wire Gmail tools to agent group A.
say_en.note: Confirms operations and runs the matching install skill.

say_en.text: Change the agent group for a trigger.
